scenario_text: Epidemiologists relate the herd immunity threshold across pathogens to the reproduction potential observed in each setting. They assemble cross-sectional pairings to characterize the critical immune fraction needed to halt spread. The relationship is an instantaneous algebraic function of transmissibility. Vaccine coverage logistics are held fixed as background.
